summary: Preview-only frontend retest of the iteration_98 colour fixes. ALL previously failing surfaces now PASS, with green rgb(16,185,129), red rgb(220,38,38) and neutral rgb(30,41,59). /dashboard/uebersicht: StatTile Heute +14,76 € and Unrealisierter G/V +320,43 € are green; 'Weitere Kennzahlen' Realisierter G/V 0,00 € is neutral. /dashboard/aktien: KPI Gewinn/Verlust +320,43 € and Tagesveränderung +14,76 € are green, and their sub-percent is muted as designed. /dashboard/aktien/AAPL: Tages-G/V -6,34 € is red; Unrealisierte G/V +86,77 €, Gesamtrendite +10,33 % and Rendite (1J) +32,49 % are green. /dashboard/anleihen (test customer has no bonds): Kurs-G/V '0,00 €' is neutral with no '+'; Marktwert/Einstand are neutral. Tagesgeld and Festgeld tiles are unchanged and neutral. PRVT3 neutral case: admin PATCH listing 40 gave 0.00/0.00. The customer IPO table (aktien and uebersicht) then showed '0,00 €' / '0,00 %' neutral with no '+', as did the main positions table and the mobile 390px view. Listing was restored to 50 (+100/+25 confirmed). Regression still passes: IPO tables, positions table, mobile cards, Top-Bewegungen badges, watchlist cards (red -0,69 %, green +0,47 %/+3,41 %) and Handeln/Markt list (green %). Manual IPO dialog (ipo-manual-assign-btn) has no 'Gewinn %' field and its live summary shows -15,00 € / -10,00 % in red. The submission created pending request 6ae344c0a682f003a0ccd48c (Oura, 3 shares) with notes='TEST_EUR_I99 Notiz manuell' and amount_eur=150.5, both persisted, with source=admin and no cash debit (customer cash stays 2000). tester@mester.de is unchanged: cash ledger hash and 45 entries are identical, and IPO requests are [].

ui_bugs.component: AnleihenPage StatTile 'Kuponertrag p.a.' and Metric 'Jährl. Kuponertrag'
ui_bugs.issue: tone='pos' is hardcoded, so the value is green even when it is exactly 0. With no bonds, '0,00 €' renders green rgb(16,185,129). This conflicts with the 'exactly 0 = neutral' rule. Use pnlToneKey(aggregates.kuponPa) / pnlToneKey(m.jahresKupon).

The sub text uses `${bondsGV >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${yieldPct.toFixed(2)} %`, which renders '+0.00 %'. That has a '+' at zero and an English decimal point instead of German '0,00 %'. Use the pnlToneKey check plus fmtDe, as in AktienPage.

Mongo rows are mapped with source:'mongo', which overwrites the backend source. An admin-created request (backend source='admin') is therefore shown with the 'KUNDENPORTAL' badge, and the 'Admin' badge branch (row.source==='admin') can never trigger.

issues: The table still clips the 'Gesch. Gewinn' column (values cut off as '+20', '-15'), as reported in iteration_98.

action_items: Optional: AnleihenPage Kuponertrag tiles should use pnlToneKey so that 0 is neutral.
Optional: AnleihenPage Kurs-G/V sub should use fmtDe and drop the '+' at 0.
Optional: preserve the backend source (admin/customer) in AdminIpoRequests mongo mapping, so admin-created rows are not labelled 'Kundenportal'.
Optional: in parseOptionalNum, '1.500,50' gives NaN and the amount is silently dropped. Strip thousand dots before replacing the comma.
Cleanup: test request 6ae344c0a682f003a0ccd48c (Oura, pending, notes TEST_EUR_I99...) for test_eur_qa.
critical_code_review_comments: formatEURSigned now uses pnlSign, so 0 shows no '+'. Verified.
AdminIpoRequests.submitManual still runs create and the valuation PATCH as two calls with no rollback. If the PATCH fails, a pending request without valuation remains.
AdminIpoRequests.js is well over 700 lines and should be split.
